_comment: Copy the 'weather-warehouse' block into your real config at:
If that file already has an mcpServers object, add this entry to it rather
than replacing the file. Restart Claude Desktop afterwards — it only reads
The command MUST be the absolute path to the venv python. Claude Desktop
does not inherit your shell PATH, so a bare 'python' will not resolve.
No password appears here: the server reads mcp_server/.env, which is mode
600 and gitignored. Keeping it out of this file means the config is safe to
copy around and the credential lives in exactly one place.
